sentence_stem: I have got a headache, so
correct_completion: I am going to take some medicine.
full_sentence: I have got a headache, so I am going to take some medicine.
acceptable_variants: I am going to rest at home.
I am going to see a doctor.

options.text: I am going to the cinema.
options.why_wrong: Going to the cinema is not a logical result of having a headache.

options.text: I have got a new phone.
options.why_wrong: This is unrelated to the headache. 'So' needs a result of the first clause.

options.text: I am going to take some medicine.

options.why_wrong: Liking chocolate does not follow from having a headache.

grammar_focus: 'So' to show a result after a present perfect clause
explanation: 'So' introduces the result of the first clause. A headache is a reason to take medicine, so the completion must describe a logical consequence.
translation: У мене болить голова, тому я збираюся прийняти ліки.
